clips.title: The story
paras: Nessa Shadowsong is sending fish samples from Rut'theran Village to Auberdine for comparison. She wants to learn whether Teldrassil's fish are larger and more plentiful than those along the mainland coast.

Nessa Shadowsong asks you to carry fish bones and scales to Laird in Auberdine. Fishers in Rut'theran Village bring in large, plentiful catches, and she wants to know whether the mainland waters yield the same kind of fish. The samples will let Laird compare the island catch with fish from the coast of Darkshore.

Nessa Shadowsong sends you to Vesprystus, the hippogryph master in Rut'theran Village, with the collection for Auberdine. Carrying the samples to him arranges your passage across the water to Darkshore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fishermen of Rut'theran village do very well, for the fish here are extremely large and abundant. I would like to compare the bounty here with that of the mainland.
I have a collection of fish bones and scales that I would like taken to a colleague of mine in Darkshore. His name is Laird, he is a fish vendor in the village of Auberdine.
Bring my collection to our hippogryph master, Vesprystus, and speak to him about traveling to Auberdine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How may I help you? Are you in need of transport?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you wish to get this to Auberdine? Very well...
